call_points.text: ROCE targeted at 12-15% this year and 20% in FY28.
FY27 capex guided at about ₹350 Cr, plus ₹20-30 Cr for the rail JV first phase.
Mexico plant production started; about ₹6 Cr revenue in Q1, significant revenue from Q3FY27.
Management will not give a full-year margin range, only promising continued quarterly improvement.
Energy and shipping costs are the main margin risk; steel is passed on with a one-quarter lag.
Margins guided 100-150 bps above Q4FY26 if energy price increases are passed on to customers.
Debt reduction of at least ₹400-500 Cr targeted in FY27, helped by promoter funding.
Rail wheel plant to start by end-May or June; 40,000 wheels to Indian Railways in FY27, about ₹400-450 Cr revenue.
Steel is a full pass-through with a one-quarter lag; gas and other consumables are the cost risk.
A ₹42 Cr ECL provision was made against the ₹42 Cr electricity duty exceptional income, which management says is fully receivable.
Shipping costs are up 15-20% and transit times 15-20 days longer.
Aerospace alloys may enter the order book by FY27-end but no revenue expected before FY29.

operating_notes.text: Railways rose to 7.5% of FY26 revenue from 4.6% a year ago.
Ring rolling ran at 121% utilisation, which management says does not affect equipment life.
Aluminium forging margins are about 14-15% on a commodity price of about ₹400 per kg.
Q1FY27 auto order wins of ₹278 Cr over four years, 82% passenger vehicle and 18% two-wheeler, all domestic; plus ₹15 Cr Metro orders.
Rail wheel JV has an 80,000-wheel confirmed order from Indian Railways plus about 25,000 wheels from JV partners, taking utilisation to about 1,10,000 wheels by end-FY28.
Mexico plant contributed about ₹6 Cr revenue in Q1FY27; significant revenue expected from Q3FY27.
